== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34658) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Marlin LS Hidden Path.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 24 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 24 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>83b2ab9db1ed27921a1b1c94a8a8f08c2fbaa834b58b0ff6004590e6f587eaf4</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
